postedPay.title: Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Senior Manager

title: Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Senior Manager
text:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The **Senior Manager, Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA)**, is responsible for leading and continuously improving all food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and quality management programs within a food manufacturing facility. This role ensures compliance with federal, state, customer, and third-party requirements, including Safe Quality Food (SQF) standards, while driving a culture of food safety, quality excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization.

As the site’s food safety and quality leader, the Senior Manager provides strategic oversight of food safety systems, audit readiness, risk management, and quality performance. Working cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, and Product Development teams, this position ensures the consistent production of safe, high-quality products from raw materials through finished goods.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the site's quality management systems, overseeing quality control activities across raw materials, in-process production, and finished products.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, and Commercial teams.
* Provide strategic oversight of product traceability, stock recovery, recall readiness, and crisis management programs.
* Establish, interpret, and continuously improve Quality Assurance and Quality Control standards, procedures, KPIs, SOPs, and GMP programs.

**Food Safety & Quality Program Leadership**

* Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of food safety and quality programs, including SQF, HACCP, HARPC, and GMP systems.
* Maintain GFSI-recognized certifications, including SQF, ensuring ongoing audit readiness and compliance.
* Ensure all food safety, quality, and regulatory documentation, procedures, and records are accurate, current, and compliant.

**Team Leadership & Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the FSQA team, including talent acquisition, succession planning, performance management, and professional development.
* Champion a strong food safety and quality culture by providing training and coaching to employees at all levels of the organization.

**Audit, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Serve as the primary lead for all regulatory, customer, and third-party audits, inspections, and certification activities.
* Direct internal audit programs and oversee corrective and preventive action plans to address non-conformances.
* Manage customer and consumer complaint programs, including root cause investigations and continuous improvement initiatives

**Regulatory & Customer Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory, customer, and certification requirements, including HACCP, FSMA, CFIA, FDA, GFSI, and SQF standards.
* Monitor emerging regulatory and industry developments and implement changes to maintain compliance and operational excellence.

**Supplier Quality Management**

* Oversee supplier approval and performance management programs to ensure all materials meet food safety and quality requirements.
* Lead supplier audits, risk assessments, and improvement initiatives to strengthen supply chain quality and compliance.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline required; Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive Food Safety and Quality Assurance experience within a food manufacturing environment, including at least 3-5 years in a leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading and maintaining SQF and other GFSI-recognized food safety systems within a complex manufacturing operation.
* Proven experience leading, developing, and coaching high-performing teams while building a strong food safety and quality culture.
* Strong knowledge of HACCP, HARPC, GMPs, FSMA, CFIA, FDA, GFSI, and SQF requirements and their practical application in food manufacturing.
* Experience leading regulatory, customer, and third-party audits, including successful management of corrective and preventive action programs.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and quality management systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence decision-making at all levels of the organization.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS**

* Expert knowledge of food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements, including FDA, CFIA, FSMA, HACCP, GMP, GFSI, and SQF standards.
* Strong understanding of food safety systems, risk assessment, hygienic zoning, sanitation, environmental monitoring, allergen management, and preventive controls.
* Proven ability to lead food safety and quality strategy within a manufacturing environment while driving a culture of compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across all levels of the organization.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical capabilities, including expertise in root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), trend analysis, and risk mitigation.
* Strong knowledge of quality management systems, data analysis, and performance metrics, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
* Demonstrated project management and change management skills, with experience leading cross-functional initiatives and implementing sustainable process improvements.
* Strong customer and regulatory audit management experience, including interactions with customers, certification bodies, and regulatory agencies.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Must be comfortable working in a bakery manufacturing environment with exposure to elevated temperatures and production equipment.
* Frequent walking and standing throughout the production facility to conduct inspections, audits, observations, and support operational activities.
* Prolonged periods of standing, walking, and sitting may be required.
* Occasional lifting, carrying, or moving of product samples, ingredients, materials, or equipment up to 25-50 lbs.
* Manual dexterity required to operate testing equipment, utilize computer systems, document findings, and review records.
* Occasional bending, reaching, climbing, and accessing equipment or storage areas during inspections, audits, and investigations.
* Exposure to varying environmental conditions, including hot production areas, cool storage environments, and refrigerated spaces.
* Strong visual acuity required to identify product defects, verify compliance standards, and review documentation.
* Ability to use sensory evaluation techniques, including sight, smell, and taste, when assessing ingredients, products, and quality attributes.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
